comment: Engine choices of SlicerX for an opened project. keeps: stay when a project opens, unless the person changed them in the project (its different_settings_to_system lists the key); note says what the open kept when the project's inherited value differs. defaults: apply only when the project does not set the key at all; a value the project sets is its own. The app, the MCP server (engine-choices.ts) and sx slice <project.3mf> (sx-core, through build.rs) all read this file. value: what SlicerX prints with.

wall_generator.note: Kept SlicerX's aegis walls; the project used Bambu's default.
